Name: Ishmael, Son of Jehohanan
Summary: Ishmael, son of Jehohanan, was one of the captains of hundreds Jehoiada took into covenant to crown Joash.
KeyStory: Jehoiada took Ishmael the son of Jehohanan into covenant with him.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Jehohanan, Father of Ishmael
LifeLesson: Faithful officers risked their lives for the LORD's anointed.
